detail.longDescription: Repurposed an old Dell Latitude 7480 laptop into a home cloud server running Xubuntu, MicroK8s, and Nextcloud! 💻☁️ Turns out a business laptop makes the ultimate mini-server with a built-in UPS (its own battery backup!). Next up: local network access, fine-tuning proxy headers, and automated backups. Who needs expensive hardware when you have old laptops? 🐧🔧 # SelfHosted # HomeLab # Nextcloud # Linux # Kubernetes
